verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI assistant built into CockroachDB or its Cloud console. The natural-language interaction described is done through the user's own external AI tools connecting to the official Cloud MCP server. That is a separate MCP-server capability, not an in-product assistant, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
